en: Sepia-toned street scene showing a row of stalls or booths along a wrought-iron fence in an urban setting. Men in traditional Middle Eastern/North African clothing sit and stand at tables, engaged in writing or clerical work—depicting modern scribes. A large tree and a streetlamp stand in the foreground. Printed caption text appears at the bottom in French, with an imprint and initials on the right.
